## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 7 captures during August 2022. Activity proceeded in line with the planned service arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. There were no reported changes to the site’s operating arrangements during the month.

The available activity provided the basis for image-quality review and subsequent grading. The capture total is reported as recorded for the site and month, without adjustment for images that could not be assessed.

## Image quality

Of the 7 captures, 1 was ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 14.3 per cent. The ungradable image was excluded from grading outcomes. The result indicates that most captures were available for assessment, while highlighting the need to continue routine attention to image acquisition and review processes.

## Grading

Grading identified 0 referable results among the assessable captures. The median lag from capture to grading was 10 days. These results are presented for the August 2022 reporting period and should be considered alongside the activity and image-quality measures above.
